# Startup Factory Hub

> AI-powered startup accelerator and business intelligence platform connecting founders, mentors, and investors with real-time data, market insights, and instant matching.

Startup Factory Hub is a white-label accelerator ecosystem that combines AI-driven founder analytics, investor matching, and live business intelligence dashboards. The platform hosts startup communities (Districts), immersive event portals, and a suite of AI tools for pitch generation, market research, and growth tracking.
